description: Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status (destination, ETA, draught) for one vessel by 9-digit MMSI, from Finland's Digitraffic AIS feed. Covers Finnish and Baltic waters only, not global coverage; vessels outside that area return no position. Related tools on this server, for a different need: logistics_imo_vessel_dossier when you need Ship particulars by IMO number: name, type, flag, MMSI; logistics_sanctioned_vessel_check when you need to search the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: logistics_vessel_tracker
title: Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status for one
